title: Two City Scheduling
goal: Send exactly half the people to each city at minimum total cost.
strategy: Compare each person by their relative A-versus-B cost, not their cheapest absolute cost. Give A seats to the smallest differences.

phasePurposes.start: Send exactly half the people to each city at minimum total cost.
phasePurposes.inspect: Compare each person by their relative A-versus-B cost, not their cheapest absolute cost. Give A seats to the smallest differences.
phasePurposes.update: Compare each person by their relative A-versus-B cost, not their cheapest absolute cost. Give A seats to the smallest differences.
phasePurposes.done: Send exactly half the people to each city at minimum total cost.

edgeCases: Two people must split between cities
Equal differences admit several optimal assignments
Every person prefers A but half must go to B
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
